title: EXPO / City Pavilion
backend: WebGPU primary; automatic WebGL2 fallback; &webgl forces WebGL2
techniques: Detailed 24-stand open-roof pavilion and 32-building city with procedural furniture, products, signs, street furniture and animated cars
Instanced articulated human crowd with CPU aisle graph traversal and animated limbs/bob
Dijkstra destination routing, animated TSL route, destination highlighting and overhead map
Day/night lighting with real-time directional shadows, six night point lights, emissive windows, TSL entrance scans and HDR bloom
limitations: Wall-frame measurements only; no GPU timestamps
CPU crowd path traversal with GPU instanced rendering; no person-to-person collision avoidance
Only directional light casts shadows; point lights are unshadowed
Entrance beams are additive cone meshes, not volumetric scattering
Overhead map uses top-down perspective rather than orthographic projection
Amenity routes terminate outside facility footprints; no indoor facility routing
Fixed 100% mode preserves all rendering work; bounded load and opt-in manual/adaptive resolution provide recovery
Temporary public URL depends on the existing cloudflared process
testSummary: PASS after native HiDPI correction: production build; isolated Chrome 1440x960 CSS / DPR2 gives 2880x1920 backing at default 120 people, max 1200 and synthetic pressure, fixed 100%/adaptive OFF. Manual 50% gives 1440x960. Both scenes pass resize and live fractional DPR changes with exact rounded sizes. 31 routes and 42660 aisle samples avoid booth/facility interiors. All 1200 walkers moved. Actual pointer picking, orbit/pan/zoom, overhead/reset, day/night, motion/wall/bloom toggles passed. WebGPU and WebGL2 default/max rendered with zero errors. Updated day/night/max screenshots inspected. Original preserved; test browser closed. Static subpath PASS: both scenes tested from dist at /eval-gpu/three-webgpu/ using strict port5182 file server (no SPA rewrite). 20 browser requests all HTTP200; zero console/request errors. Scene links, direct exhibition query, night, route/picking, WebGL2, 2880x1920 Retina backing at default/max, and manual half resolution passed.
runCommand: npm ci && npm run build && npm run preview

staticHosting.notes: Copy only dist contents into the site three-webgpu directory. Original local/public URLs intentionally unchanged.
